messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for **Canada – 2023**.  
A *long weekend* here means a statutory holiday that lands on a **Friday** or **Monday**, creating at least three consecutive non‑working days (the holiday itself plus the adjoining weekend).  

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Provinces / Territories Covered | Notes |
|-------------|---------|---------------------------------|-------|
| **January 2** | New Year’s Day (Observed) | All provinces & territories | January 1 was a Sunday → the holiday moved to Monday, giving a 3‑day break (Sat–Sun–Mon). |
| **February 20** | Family Day | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario | Falls on a Monday → 3‑day break (Fri–Sat–Mon). *(Note: Manitoba, Québec, Nunavut, Northwest Territory, Yukon, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Labrador, and the rest of Atlantic Canada do NOT observe Family Day.)* |
| **March 31** | Good Friday | Most provinces & territories (except Québec) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in almost all jurisdictions → 3‑day break (Thu–Fri–Sat). |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | All provinces & territories | Last Monday before June 1 → 3‑day break (Fri–Sat–Mon). |
| **June 12** | National Indigenous Peoples’ Day (Observance) | Only in the territory of Nunavut (and occasionally celebrated informally elsewhere) | Observed on Tuesday in Nunavut; does **not** form a long weekend. |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | All provinces & territories | First Monday in September → 3‑day break (Fri–Sat–Mon). |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | All provinces & territories | Second Monday in October → 3‑day break (Fri–Sat–Mon). |

### Quick Reference Cheat Sheet

```
Long Weekend Holidays (2023)
----------------------------
01-Jan   — New Year’s Day (falls on Sunday → observed Mon 02-Jan)
20-Feb   — Family Day (AB, BC, SK, ON)          [Mon]
07-Apr   — Good Friday (most provinces)         [Fri]
22-May   — Victoria Day                         [Mon]
04-Sep   — Labour Day                           [Mon]
09-Oct   — Thanksgiving                        [Mon]
```

> **Tip for App Integration:**  
> Store the above dates in your database as `YYYY-MM-DD` strings. When generating calendars, flag any event whose `date.weekday()` equals `0` (Monday) or `4` (Friday) as a potential long‑weekend trigger. This allows users to see automatically how many consecutive days off they’ll enjoy without having to manually calculate adjacency to Saturdays/Sundaries.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like more granular details—such as province‑specific holidays beyond the long weekends—or help formatting this data for your particular tech stack!
